nonblocking_findings.problem: When main_health refuses a snapshot, it attaches resource_guard_inputs to the exception. The outer failure JSON saves repr/traceback only, so that instantaneous service/queue input is not preserved.
nonblocking_findings.impact: Fail-stop remains intact and no service starts through a failed guard. A subsequent health investigation cannot reconstruct the exact rejected snapshot from this failure JSON alone.
nonblocking_findings.minimal_correction: In a future separately sealed version, add getattr(e, resource_guard_inputs, None) to the failure receipt. No change to the health predicate or scientific body is needed.

limits: This is launcher source review and in-memory fixtures, not actual bound metadata, host resource verification or real-image canary acceptance.
The original25-member scientific implementation was not re-audited; only connected identity and sequential-child entry were read.
Root must supply and verify actual approval, bound offserver/root/package/source/baseline SHA pins and run the existing fresh Linux resource guards.
